title: RegularFacet
description: Provides a string/specific-value facet for a commerce search surface. Renders selectable facet values, supports facet search, and dispatches value-selection, facet-search, and show-more/less actions.

RegularFacetState.title: RegularFacetState
RegularFacetState.description: The current regular facet state. Owned exclusively by the backend.

field.description: The index field the facet is built on.

values.description: The facet values available for selection.

hasActiveValues.description: Whether at least one facet value is not in the idle state (i.e. selected or excluded).

canShowMoreValues.description: Whether more facet values can be shown.

canShowLessValues.description: Whether fewer facet values can be shown.

RegularFacetValue.title: RegularFacetValue
RegularFacetValue.description: A single selectable value within a regular facet.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results matching this facet value.

state.description: The selection state of this facet value.

RegularFacetSearch.title: RegularFacetSearch
RegularFacetSearch.description: The facet search state for a regular facet.

canShowMoreResults.description: Whether more facet search results can be shown for the current query.

RegularFacetSearchResult.title: RegularFacetSearchResult
RegularFacetSearchResult.description: A single result returned by a regular facet search. Facet search only returns idle (unselected) values, so it carries no selection state.

value.description: The raw facet value. Pass this to toggleSelect/toggleExclude to act on it.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results matching this facet search value.

RegularFacetToggleSelectAction.title: regularFacetToggleSelect
RegularFacetToggleSelectAction.description: Toggles the selected state of a facet value.

value.description: The raw facet value to toggle selection for.

RegularFacetToggleExcludeAction.title: regularFacetToggleExclude
RegularFacetToggleExcludeAction.description: Toggles the excluded state of a facet value.

value.description: The raw facet value to toggle exclusion for.

RegularFacetClearAllActiveValuesAction.title: regularFacetClearAllActiveValues
RegularFacetClearAllActiveValuesAction.description: Resets all facet values to the idle state, clearing every selection and exclusion.

RegularFacetSearchAction.title: search
RegularFacetSearchAction.description: Runs a facet search with the given query.

query.description: The facet search query to run.

RegularFacetShowMoreSearchResultsAction.title: regularFacetShowMoreSearchResults
RegularFacetShowMoreSearchResultsAction.description: Requests the next page of facet search results for the current query.

RegularFacetClearSearchAction.title: regularFacetClearSearch
RegularFacetClearSearchAction.description: Clears the facet search query and results.

RegularFacetShowMoreValuesAction.title: showMoreValues
RegularFacetShowMoreValuesAction.description: Increases the number of facet values shown.

RegularFacetShowLessValuesAction.title: showLessValues
RegularFacetShowLessValuesAction.description: Decreases the number of facet values shown.
